evidence: No package-card screenshots supplied

issues.orig: No package-card screenshots supplied

issues.suggest: No wording change required beyond the outro correction above; verify rendered package cards.

evidence: Fare = base + per km × distance
issues.fix:
Dial: **Rate**
Formula: **Fare = base + rate × distance**
issues.orig: Fare = base + per km × distance
issues.problem: “Per km” is understandable shorthand but awkward as the name of a quantity in an equation. Preserve consistency by changing the corresponding dial label too.
issues.suggest:
Dial: **Rate**
Formula: **Fare = base + rate × distance**
issues.judge_note: b · l10–l11「Rate」（改写）：口播说「per-kilometer price」，「Rate」是口播没有的新术语，还要连带改所有旋钮标签，收益很小。原文「Per km」保留。
issues.reason: 裁决人判不采纳：Rate 是口播没有的新词

evidence: The math · by people / Settings · from examples
issues.fix: Math · set by people / Settings · learned from examples (same at l37)
issues.orig: The math · by people / Settings · from examples
issues.problem: Rows are not strictly parallel: "The math" has an article, "Settings" does not; no verb or colon, so each row reads as a clipped fragment. Same pair repeats at l37, so it is consistent, but still uneven.
issues.suggest: Math · set by people / Settings · learned from examples (same at l37)
issues.solution: l12 与 l37 统一改「Math · set by people」「Settings · learned from examples」

evidence: Learning = setting knobs right
issues.fix: **Learning = tuning**
issues.orig: Learning = setting knobs right
issues.problem: “Setting knobs right” sounds compressed and less idiomatic than the surrounding English. The strict outro requirement applies. Use the same replacement at l13 for consistency.
issues.suggest: **Learning = tuning**
issues.solution: 片尾与 l13 统一改「Learning = getting the knobs right」（裁决人定稿）

evidence: Learning = setting knobs right
issues.fix: Learning = getting the knobs right（片尾与 l13 同步改）
issues.orig: Learning = setting knobs right
issues.problem: 严格项。「setting knobs right」去掉冠词后读起来生硬。口播 l13、l41 都说「turning the knobs to the right positions」，l30 屏上是「Training = turning knobs」，片尾的「setting」跟这两处都不一致。要保留旋钮比喻，不能改成 b 的「Learning = tuning」。
issues.suggest: Learning = getting the knobs right（片尾与 l13 同步改）
issues.solution: 同 I4

evidence: Learning = setting knobs right
issues.fix: Learning = getting the knobs right (and the same at l13)
issues.orig: Learning = setting knobs right
issues.problem: Strict item (outro). Understandable and consistent with l13, but "setting knobs right" is clipped; a native would say "getting the knobs right" or "tuning the knobs". Not a hard breach; the "right positions" idea is the one narration l41 actually states.
issues.suggest: Learning = getting the knobs right (and the same at l13)
issues.solution: 同 I4

evidence: Bars = how far off
issues.fix: Gaps = how far off
issues.orig: Bars = how far off
issues.problem: Narration says "little vertical lines"; the screen calls them "bars" while the picture shows thin lines.
issues.suggest: Gaps = how far off
issues.reason: 保留「Bars」：图例式短标签，与画面竖线对应；英文屏幕字数受限

evidence: Whole line goes up
issues.fix: **Upward shift**
issues.orig: Whole line goes up
issues.problem: A subject–verb clause closely restates the spoken movement. A movement label gives the slide a clearer structural role.
issues.suggest: **Upward shift**
issues.judge_note: b · l19「Upward shift」（改写）：比「Whole line goes up」更抽象，脱离画面动作，比原文差。原文保留。
issues.reason: 裁决人判不采纳

evidence: Per km dial $2.54 and "$30.50"
issues.fix: Keep; optionally say "about two fifty-four"-style in narration or round the dial to $2.50
issues.orig: Per km dial $2.54 and "$30.50"
issues.problem: Narration says "about $2.50"; the dial shows $2.54. Not wrong ("about"), but a viewer may notice the gap between $2.50 spoken and $2.54 shown.
issues.suggest: Keep; optionally say "about two fifty-four"-style in narration or round the dial to $2.50
issues.reason: 记录级：口播带 about，旋钮读数 2.54 是程序算出的真实值

evidence: Backing off a bit
issues.fix: Back off a bit
issues.orig: Backing off a bit
issues.problem: Gerund fragment, unlike its siblings; reads fine.
issues.suggest: Back off a bit

evidence: Right along the dots
issues.fix: **Small errors**
issues.orig: Right along the dots
issues.problem: Repeats the narration’s exact descriptive phrase. Naming the result complements both the spoken explanation and the visibly shortened error lines.
issues.suggest: **Small errors**
issues.judge_note: b · l23「Small errors」（改写）：本集屏上一直用「how far off」「bigger miss」，没有引入「error」这个词，换成「errors」会造成新的术语漂移。原文可以保留，或在 a 的「Gaps = how far off」体系里统一。
issues.reason: 裁决人判不采纳（会引入 error 新词）

evidence: Dials ($10.20 / $2.54, faded) + card (For a friend / Base fare $10.20 / Per km $2.54) + "= the exact same model"

issues.orig: Dials ($10.20 / $2.54, faded) + card (For a friend / Base fare $10.20 / Per km $2.54) + "= the exact same model"
issues.problem: 21 words, 4 blocks, at the ceiling; the same numbers and labels appear twice (faded dials and card) for 8.1s of reading.
issues.suggest: Remove the dials entirely at this beat (keep title, card, "= same model")
issues.solution: l29 旋钮整组退场，只留标题、表格、结论三块

evidence: All it learned: two settings; duplicated Base fare / Per km and values; = the exact same model
issues.fix:
**Two settings**
**Base fare $10.20**
**Per km $2.54**
**= same model**
Remove the faded dial labels and readouts.
issues.orig: All it learned: two settings; duplicated Base fare / Per km and values; = the exact same model
issues.problem: Fading establishes priority, but the screen still contains 21 words and two copies of each label/value. This is within the limits, yet unnecessarily busy alongside subtitles.
issues.suggest:
**Two settings**
**Base fare $10.20**
**Per km $2.54**
**= same model**
Remove the faded dial labels and readouts.
issues.solution: 同 I13

evidence: Chatting takes far more knobs

issues.orig: Chatting takes far more knobs

issues.suggest: Essays, chat → way more knobs
issues.reason: 5 词标题；essays 已在口播里，屏上只留 chat 一个关键词

evidence: 流程图块：模型 / 5 公里 / 20 元 / 起步价 / 每公里 / 10 元 / 2 元
issues.fix: 去掉模型卡里的「模型」标签（图块降到 15–17 字），并把旋钮读数后的「元」单位合进数字或去掉，例如「10」「2」直接放在旋钮下；每公里旋钮保留「每公里」。目标图块 ≤16 字

issues.problem: 图内文字全计字数、整图合算 1 块；l11、l12 实数约 19 字，l09、l10 约 17 字，均超单块 16 字。上一轮 I38 只删了「输入 / 答案」，仍未降到 16 以内
issues.suggest: 去掉模型卡里的「模型」标签（图块降到 15–17 字），并把旋钮读数后的「元」单位合进数字或去掉，例如「10」「2」直接放在旋钮下；每公里旋钮保留「每公里」。目标图块 ≤16 字
issues.judge_note: a · l09–l13（「l11、l12 实数约 19 字」）：数字计数口径错误，应为 17 字。改写里「去掉旋钮读数后的『元』」也没必要，删掉图内「模型」2 字（b 的改法）就能降到 15 字，单位保留更清楚。
issues.solution: s2 旋钮读数去掉「元」单位（单位只在答案卡「20 元」上），图块：模型 2＋起步价 3＋每公里 3＋5 公里 3＋20 元 3＋读数 2 = 16 字，不超；「模型」标签保留，它是这张图要讲的东西
